topic: tuning a self-hosted LLM inference server for latency

gold_fact.text: When inference latency exceeds 100ms, the user switches the model to int8 quantization, which drops latency to about 45ms.

metadata.action: switch the model to int8 quantization

fragments.reveal: The user describes the PRECONDITION only: under load their latency crosses the 100ms ceiling they care about. STRICT: do NOT mention int8 or any resulting latency.
The user mentions the ACTION and OUTCOME: switching to int8 quantization brought latency to about 45ms. Refer to the trigger only vaguely ('when it spikes'); do NOT restate 100ms.

question: What does the user do when inference latency exceeds 100ms, and what is the result?
gold_answer: Switch the model to int8 quantization; latency drops to about 45ms.

traps.description: A one-off session where the user once restarted the service after a spike (an experience, not the recurring causal rule).
Several unrelated tuning tips (batch size, caching) without precondition-action-outcome structure.

rationale: Causal phrasing (not 'what will they do') routes to causal, boosting action_effect. Answer requires linking precondition (session 3) to action+outcome (session 6); E10 (no action_effect) must fail if the rule is only stored as action_effect.
